title: 推し接近アラート、発令！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back after a day out with Agnes Digital, she brings me to an "Umamusume Shop."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: They're in stock! They've got the goods for the brand-new Uma raffle! Let's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I really want the A prize! It's a tapestry with all the members of the student council on it! Oooh, I'm sooo nervous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep, beep, beep!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hya! It sounds like it came from my body!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Everything seems operational. Data is being received. Heh-heh, very good!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Heart rate is at 110 BPM. Hmmm, that's surprising. Just get her a little nervous and her heart rate rises to an active level akin to jogging.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Tachyon?! Are you measuring my heart rate?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Indeed, I am. I took the liberty of attaching a micro device to you while you were sound asleep last night.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: While I was sleeping?! Y-you mean you got that close to me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't feel a thing. To the untrained eye, it appears as no more than a mole on the back of your neck.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Th-th-the back of m-my n-neck?! Aaaghghghgh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BEEPBEEPBEEPBEEPBEEPBEEP!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You're releasing this much dopamine from imagination alone?! Heh-heh, it's like you're practically running a race, your heart rate is so high!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wheeze, wheeze! S-sorry about that… I think I've managed to calm down.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Your heart is tough enough to tolerate such massive swings of activity in such a short time… Fascinating, just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's bring you back to that state of excitement once again. You can never have too much data!
choice_data_list: I'm sure she'd be excited if she won the A prize…
Don't put any more stress on her, please!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm, I assume you're referring to this raffle? In that case, I'll win this "A prize" you speak of and then give it to her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?! You'd do that for me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I provide the A prize, you provide the data. In other words, it's an equal exchange of value. Nothing to be concerned about.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh! If y-y-you do that for me, then…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It appears the likelihood of drawing the A prize is about two percent… But there's room for intervention in all matters. If I put my scientific abilities to use, that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Here it is! The height of my research! A success born from the collective fruits of every branch of science!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Just kidding. Cheaters never win, as they say. Unfortunately, all I managed was the G prize—a clear folder.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Please accept it as thanks for participating in my experi—um, Digital?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep… Beep beep… Beep… Pssssh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Is this the world that awaits those with a wealth of good karma? Or is this the place where punishment is doled out on those who accept gifts from their oshis?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: However… So long as Umamusume are here, who cares?! Here, Uma Uma Uma! Where are yooou? Hueueue! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It seems her excitement has reached a state where it has begun affecting her brain's limbic system. And without even receiving the A prize! How profoundly curious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital lolls around in her dream world for some time after.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… As far as I know, Digital is well within the limits of what she can tolerate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But, all right. At the overprotective trainer's insistence, I'll call it here for today. At the least, I managed to acquire some data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I suppose that means I should remove my micro device. Give me your neck for a second, Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: H-hyah! Tachyon! Don't come near me while I'm already—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BEEPBEEPBEEPBEEPBEEPBEEP!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: HWAAAAGH! My cells are on fiiiiire!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Look at all this data pouring in! What a fortunate accident!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the experiment ends, Agnes Digital looks languid, yet profoundly happy.
